note: Every row reproduces byte for byte from the fields beside it. A row with an invariant is aimed: quint is asked to refute 'this label never occurs' and the counterexample is kept. A row with none is an ordinary walk.

goldens.name: budgeted-walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk. It is where the ordinary labels come from, and where the three cheap exemption arms — settled, ticket-released and the desk-only revoke — are fired without being asked for.

goldens.name: budgeted-execution-blocked
goldens.purpose: Infrastructure refuses to run an intact contract. It is not failed work: the set retires as cancelled, no rework or finalization budget is spent, and the wall names its own reason.

goldens.name: budgeted-eval-stage-passed
goldens.purpose: The stage advance, which stepDescends deliberately does not exempt: it must descend like any other progress step, and that is the stage digit earning its keep.

goldens.name: budgeted-rework-finalization-failed
goldens.purpose: A finalizer reports failure and the ticket re-enters work, spending its finalization account and its gas.

goldens.name: budgeted-work-failed
goldens.purpose: The work wall, and the operator-retry that follows it — which is where the pre-work resume exemption arm is fired.

goldens.name: budgeted-finalization-budget-exhausted
goldens.purpose: The finalization account runs out before gas does, so the wall names that account rather than gas.

goldens.name: budgeted-rework-budget-exhausted
goldens.purpose: The rework budget spent out while gas remains, which is the branch gas_exhausted is not.

goldens.name: budgeted-handoff-retry
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "ticket-resumed" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or t.to == PublishingHandoff))
goldens.purpose: An accepted promotion whose publication cannot be proven enters the hold and an operator retry returns only to publication.

goldens.name: budgeted-direct-finalization-succeeded
goldens.purpose: A managed finalizer without a post-promotion handoff retains its direct successful completion route.

goldens.name: budgeted-handoff-succeeded
goldens.purpose: A publication success completes the ticket only after the accepted promotion.

goldens.name: budgeted-handoff-abandoned
goldens.purpose: An operator can terminally abandon a blocked handoff without recording successful completion.

goldens.name: deadline-only-walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk under gas-only gate pricing, so the instance contributes traces the budgeted rows cannot.

goldens.name: deadline-only-gas-exhausted
goldens.purpose: The gas account emptied by the uncapped gate loop DeadlineOnly allows. Under Budgeted the finalization budget runs out first, so this is the branch that reaches it.

goldens.name: retryfree-walk
goldens.purpose: The unaimed walk on the free-retry instance.

goldens.name: retryfree-free-resume
goldens.invariant: not(lastStep.label == "ticket-resumed" and lastStep.transitions.foldl(false, (b, t) => b or (Set(Evaluating, Finalizing).contains(t.to) and tickets.get(t.ticket).resumePricing == RetryFree)))
goldens.purpose: The RetryFree CHURN arm: a pipeline resume that costs nothing. It is the arm freeClimbNever is violated by, and the reason a ticket may be authored RetryFree at all.
